litigation.mdlName: In re: Bair Hugger Forced Air Warming Devices Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, District of Minnesota

phase: Active MDL; plaintiff fact-sheet compliance and case administration
phaseDetail: JPML lists MDL-2666 as active before Senior Judge Joan N. Ericksen. A January 2026 report and recommendation describes the court's process for requiring verified plaintiff fact sheets and recommending dismissal when plaintiffs do not comply. The public court page does not announce a new bellwether trial date or global settlement program.

settlements.label: No global settlement program identified in reviewed records
settlements.detail: The District of Minnesota public MDL page and the official records reviewed September 22, 2026 do not announce a global settlement program, compensation schedule, or universal payment deadline for Bair Hugger infection claims. Dismissals and individual case outcomes do not establish a global resolution.
settlements.individualClaims: No individual payment amount or universal payout schedule is verified here.
settlements.source: District of Minnesota Bair Hugger MDL page

keyDates.label: MDL-2666 established
keyDates.detail: JPML centralized federal Bair Hugger cases in the District of Minnesota before Judge Joan N. Ericksen.

keyDates.label: District court excluded general-causation experts and entered summary judgment
keyDates.detail: The order closed the remaining member cases at that stage. The Eighth Circuit later reversed the general-causation ruling in 2021.

keyDates.label: Eighth Circuit reversed the MDL-wide expert exclusion
keyDates.detail: The appellate court held that the district court abused its discretion by excluding the plaintiffs' general-causation experts on the record before it and reversed the related summary judgment.
keyDates.source: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit

keyDates.label: Plaintiff fact-sheet enforcement process adopted
keyDates.detail: The court adopted a process for identifying cases with missing verified plaintiff fact sheets and issuing orders to show cause before recommending dismissal.
keyDates.source: District of Minnesota report and recommendation

keyDates.label: 8,433 actions pending
keyDates.detail: JPML reports 8,433 pending actions and 10,739 historical actions in MDL-2666.

updates.summary: The public MDL and official records reviewed do not announce a new bellwether date or global settlement program; case administration and plaintiff fact-sheet compliance remain active issues.
JPML reports 8,433 pending actions and 10,739 historical actions, compared with 8,407 pending and 10,716 historical actions on August 3.
A report and recommendation describes the court's continuing process for verified plaintiff fact sheets and possible dismissal of noncompliant individual cases.
